title: Why are AI data centers using so much electricity? - Sajan Saini
speaker: TED-Ed
zh: 【TED-Ed】為什麼人工智慧資料中心要消耗這麼多的電力？ - 薩揚賽尼（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: Since 2019, over a thousand imposing warehouse campuses
cues.en: Since 2019, over a thousand imposing warehouse campuses
cues.zh: 自2019年以來，超過千個宏偉的倉庫園區

cues.text: have popped up around the world.
cues.en: have popped up around the world.
cues.zh: 已經出現在世界各地。

cues.text: Each complex covers nearly 100,000 square meters, uses as much water as a small town, and as much electricity as a small city.
cues.en: Each complex covers nearly 100,000 square meters, uses as much water as a small town, and as much electricity as a small city.
cues.zh: 每個綜合大樓佔地近10萬平方米，用水量相當於小鎮，用電量相當於小城市。

cues.text: These are AI data centers— facilities for running and training Large Language Models
cues.en: These are AI data centers— facilities for running and training Large Language Models
cues.zh: 這些是人工智慧資料中心——用於執行和訓練大型語言模型的設施

cues.text: like Claude and ChatGPT.
cues.en: like Claude and ChatGPT.
cues.zh: 如 Claude 和 ChatGPT。

cues.text: We’ve had similar data centers dedicated to operating the internet since the 2000s,
cues.en: We’ve had similar data centers dedicated to operating the internet since the 2000s,
cues.zh: 自 2000 年代以來，我們就擁有類似的專門用於營運網路的資料中心，

cues.text: but these customized complexes come with a whole new suite
cues.en: but these customized complexes come with a whole new suite
cues.zh: 但這些客製化的綜合體配備了全新的套件

cues.text: of challenges and possibilities.
cues.en: of challenges and possibilities.
cues.zh: 的挑戰和可能性。

cues.text: AI data centers are generally organized into several zones.
cues.en: AI data centers are generally organized into several zones.
cues.zh: 人工智慧資料中心通常分為幾個區域。

cues.text: The Network Operations Center manages data traffic and power consumption.
cues.en: The Network Operations Center manages data traffic and power consumption.
cues.zh: 網路營運中心管理資料流量和功耗。

cues.text: Power systems including transformers, gas generators, and battery-powered backups
cues.en: Power systems including transformers, gas generators, and battery-powered backups
cues.zh: 電力系統，包括變壓器、燃氣發電機和備用電池

cues.text: ensure uninterrupted electricity flow.
cues.en: ensure uninterrupted electricity flow.
cues.zh: 確保電力不間斷。

cues.text: And a connectivity hub called the Meet-Me-Room directs incoming data into the heart of the data center:
cues.en: And a connectivity hub called the Meet-Me-Room directs incoming data into the heart of the data center:
cues.zh: 名為 Meet-Me-Room 的連線中心將傳入資料引導至資料中心的核心：

cues.text: the server room.
cues.en: the server room.
cues.zh: 伺服器機房。

cues.text: When you ask an LLM a question, your prompt enters one of these server rooms.
cues.en: When you ask an LLM a question, your prompt enters one of these server rooms.
cues.zh: 當您向法學碩士提問時，您的提示會進入這些伺服器機房之一。

cues.text: It's too complicated to explore how that model responds right now,
cues.en: It's too complicated to explore how that model responds right now,
cues.zh: 現在探索模型如何反應太複雜了，

cues.text: but it involves doing tons of math.
cues.en: but it involves doing tons of math.
cues.zh: 但這涉及做大量的數學。

cues.text: To manage these calculations, a data center relies on thousands of server racks,
cues.en: To manage these calculations, a data center relies on thousands of server racks,
cues.zh: 為了管理這些計算，資料中心依賴數千個伺服器機架，

cues.text: each stacked with trays containing server boards that house memory chips and GPUs.
cues.en: each stacked with trays containing server boards that house memory chips and GPUs.
cues.zh: 每個託盤都堆疊著裝有儲存晶片和 GPU 的伺服器主機板的託盤。

cues.text: These powerhouse microchips use thousands of tiny computing cores
cues.en: These powerhouse microchips use thousands of tiny computing cores
cues.zh: 這些強大的微晶片使用數千個微型計算核心

cues.text: working in parallel to do trillions of mathematical operations per second.
cues.en: working in parallel to do trillions of mathematical operations per second.
cues.zh: 並行工作，每秒執行數萬億次數學運算。

cues.text: While most prompts only require a few GPUs to answer,
cues.en: While most prompts only require a few GPUs to answer,
cues.zh: 雖然大多數提示只需要幾個 GPU 即可回答，

cues.text: data centers already field tens of thousands of prompts a second.
cues.en: data centers already field tens of thousands of prompts a second.
cues.zh: 資料中心已經每秒發出數以萬計的提示。

cues.text: And that rate is growing fast.
cues.en: And that rate is growing fast.
cues.zh: 而且這個速度正在快速成長。

cues.text: Plus, training LLMS requires hundreds of thousands of GPUs working together,
cues.en: Plus, training LLMS requires hundreds of thousands of GPUs working together,
cues.zh: 另外，訓練 LLMS 需要數十萬個 GPU 協同工作，

cues.text: making server grids like these essential to get an AI up and running.
cues.en: making server grids like these essential to get an AI up and running.
cues.zh: 製作這樣的伺服器網格對於人工智慧的啟動和執行至關重要。

cues.text: However, all this energy-intensive work leads to a major problem: heat.
cues.en: However, all this energy-intensive work leads to a major problem: heat.
cues.zh: 然而，所有這些能源密集型工作都會導致一個主要問題：熱。

cues.text: Even in climate-controlled server rooms, GPUs get hot enough to melt server boards.
cues.en: Even in climate-controlled server rooms, GPUs get hot enough to melt server boards.
cues.zh: 即使在氣候控制的伺服器機房中，GPU 也會變得很熱，足以融化伺服器主機板。

cues.text: And the copper wires connecting these chips constantly dissipate energy,
cues.en: And the copper wires connecting these chips constantly dissipate energy,
cues.zh: 而連線這些晶片的銅線不斷地耗散能量，

cues.text: using more electricity and generating additional heat.
cues.en: using more electricity and generating additional heat.
cues.zh: 使用更多的電力並產生額外的熱量。

cues.text: Fortunately, engineers are on the job.
cues.en: Fortunately, engineers are on the job.
cues.zh: 幸運的是，工程師們都在工作。

cues.text: To cool chips, they’re using tried-and-true solutions like water towers that absorb and evaporate heat
cues.en: To cool chips, they’re using tried-and-true solutions like water towers that absorb and evaporate heat
cues.zh: 為了冷卻晶片，他們使用了經過驗證的解決方案，例如吸收和蒸發熱量的水塔

cues.text: alongside new approaches like piping chilled water behind server boards,
cues.en: alongside new approaches like piping chilled water behind server boards,
cues.zh: 除了在伺服器主機板後面輸送冷凍水等新方法之外，

cues.text: or dunking entire trays into non-conductive cooling liquids.
cues.en: or dunking entire trays into non-conductive cooling liquids.
cues.zh: 或將整個託盤浸入不導電的冷卻液中。

cues.text: At the same time, they're replacing inefficient copper wires
cues.en: At the same time, they're replacing inefficient copper wires
cues.zh: 同時，他們正在更換效率低下的銅線

cues.text: that transmit data through electricity with optical fibers that transmit data through light.
cues.en: that transmit data through electricity with optical fibers that transmit data through light.
cues.zh: 透過電傳輸資料，透過光傳輸資料的光纖。

cues.text: At the top of many racks, optical transceivers convert electrical data to light signals,
cues.en: At the top of many racks, optical transceivers convert electrical data to light signals,
cues.zh: 在許多機架的頂部，光收發器將電資料轉換為光訊號，

cues.text: which travel through optical fibers with higher data fidelity than copper
cues.en: which travel through optical fibers with higher data fidelity than copper
cues.zh: 透過光纖傳輸，資料保真度高於銅纜

cues.text: and near-zero power loss.
cues.en: and near-zero power loss.
cues.zh: 和接近零的功率損耗。

cues.text: And as photonics technology gets further integrated inside servers,
cues.en: And as photonics technology gets further integrated inside servers,
cues.zh: 隨著光子技術在伺服器內部進一步整合，

cues.text: it can solve another major problem.
cues.en: it can solve another major problem.
cues.zh: 它可以解決另一個主要問題。

cues.text: GPUs only have so much space for copper connections,
cues.en: GPUs only have so much space for copper connections,
cues.zh: GPU 的銅連線空間有限，

cues.text: limiting how much data they transmit at once.
cues.en: limiting how much data they transmit at once.
cues.zh: 限制它們一次傳輸的資料量。

cues.text: But integrated photonic chips can use different wavelengths of light
cues.en: But integrated photonic chips can use different wavelengths of light
cues.zh: 但整合光子晶片可以使用不同波長的光

cues.text: to send multiple streams of data over a few optical lines.
cues.en: to send multiple streams of data over a few optical lines.
cues.zh: 透過幾條光線路傳送多個資料流。

cues.text: This same tech could even let GPUs interact with memory chips
cues.en: This same tech could even let GPUs interact with memory chips
cues.zh: 同樣的技術甚至可以讓 GPU 與記憶體晶片互動

cues.text: on neighboring trays and racks— spreading out their heat load and allowing bigger LLMs to use less power.
cues.en: on neighboring trays and racks— spreading out their heat load and allowing bigger LLMs to use less power.
cues.zh: 在相鄰的託盤和機架上 - 分散熱負荷並允許更大的法學碩士使用更少的電力。

cues.text: While some experts believe integrated photonics will reduce data center power use by nearly 50%,
cues.en: While some experts believe integrated photonics will reduce data center power use by nearly 50%,
cues.zh: 雖然一些專家認為整合光子學將使資料中心的能耗減少近 50%，

cues.text: this still might not be enough.
cues.en: this still might not be enough.
cues.zh: 這可能還不夠。

cues.text: GPUs run at roughly 16 light bulbs worth of energy.
cues.en: GPUs run at roughly 16 light bulbs worth of energy.
cues.zh: GPU 的運作能耗大約相當於 16 個燈泡。

cues.text: Multiply that by every GPU in a data center, and you're looking at enough energy to power 300,000 homes.
cues.en: Multiply that by every GPU in a data center, and you're looking at enough energy to power 300,000 homes.
cues.zh: 將其乘以資料中心中的每個 GPU，您將獲得足夠的能源來為 300,000 個家庭供電。

cues.text: Companies are also pursuing ever-smarter AI, which, so far, has meant ever-larger AI.
cues.en: Companies are also pursuing ever-smarter AI, which, so far, has meant ever-larger AI.
cues.zh: 公司也在追求更智慧的人工智慧，到目前為止，這意味著更強大的人工智慧。

cues.text: Even with increasing efficiencies, larger models require bigger data centers and more electricity.
cues.en: Even with increasing efficiencies, larger models require bigger data centers and more electricity.
cues.zh: 即使效率不斷提高，更大的模型也需要更大的資料中心和更多的電力。

cues.text: Some estimates predict that by 2028, US data centers alone could be using as much energy as eight New York Citys.
cues.en: Some estimates predict that by 2028, US data centers alone could be using as much energy as eight New York Citys.
cues.zh: 據估計，到 2028 年，光是美國資料中心的能源消耗量就相當於八個紐約市的能源消耗量。

cues.text: In fact, some AI companies have already proposed pairing next-gen data centers
cues.en: In fact, some AI companies have already proposed pairing next-gen data centers
cues.zh: 事實上，一些人工智慧公司已經提出配對下一代資料中心

cues.text: with their own personal nuclear power plant.
cues.en: with their own personal nuclear power plant.
cues.zh: 擁有自己的個人核電廠。

cues.text: Clearly, we don’t have enough energy to support this rapid expansion,
cues.en: Clearly, we don’t have enough energy to support this rapid expansion,
cues.zh: 顯然，我們沒有足夠的能量來支援這種快速擴張，

cues.text: so we either need to hit the brakes or find ways to compute smarter.
cues.en: so we either need to hit the brakes or find ways to compute smarter.
cues.zh: 所以我們要嘛需要踩煞車，要嘛找到更聰明的計算方法。

cues.text: For example, while current LLMs are designed to answer every possible question,
cues.en: For example, while current LLMs are designed to answer every possible question,
cues.zh: 例如，雖然目前的法學碩士旨在回答每個可能的問題，

cues.text: you don’t need a model that knows Shakespeare to help you fix your dishwasher.
cues.en: you don’t need a model that knows Shakespeare to help you fix your dishwasher.
cues.zh: 您不需要了解莎士比亞的模特兒來幫助您修理洗碗機。

cues.text: We could design topic-specific “small language models” stored in micro-data centers.
cues.en: We could design topic-specific “small language models” stored in micro-data centers.
cues.zh: 我們可以設計儲存在微型資料中心的特定主題的「小語言模型」。

cues.text: Alternately, tomorrow’s LLMs might employ new forms of optical computing
cues.en: Alternately, tomorrow’s LLMs might employ new forms of optical computing
cues.zh: 或者，明天的法學碩士可能會採用新形式的光學計算

cues.text: that cut energy costs by using light itself to do the math.
cues.en: that cut energy costs by using light itself to do the math.
cues.zh: 透過利用光本身進行數學計算來降低能源成本。

cues.text: But it won’t matter how efficient these systems get if our hunger for AI keeps increasing.
cues.en: But it won’t matter how efficient these systems get if our hunger for AI keeps increasing.
cues.zh: 但如果我們對人工智慧的渴望不斷增加，這些系統的效率有多高都無關緊要。

cues.text: Ultimately, this isn’t a technical problem, it’s a social one:
cues.en: Ultimately, this isn’t a technical problem, it’s a social one:
cues.zh: 歸根究底，這不是技術問題，而是社會問題：

cues.text: just how many resources are we willing to spend to build smarter machines?
cues.en: just how many resources are we willing to spend to build smarter machines?
cues.zh: 我們願意花多少資源來建造更聰明的機器？
